# Ensure amazon_token exists; if not, login
if 'amazon_token' not in globals() or not amazon_token:
    pw_list = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
    amz_pw = next((x.get('password') for x in pw_list if x.get('account_name')=='amazon'), None)
    login_resp = apis.amazon.login(username='st-maldonado@gmail.com', password=amz_pw)
    amazon_token = login_resp.get('access_token')

cart = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=amazon_token)
cart_items = cart.get('cart_items', [])

stapler_keywords = ['stapler']
def is_stapler(item):
    name = (item.get('product_name') or '').lower()
    return any(k in name for k in stapler_keywords)

stapler_items = [it for it in cart_items if is_stapler(it)]
non_stapler_items = [it for it in cart_items if not is_stapler(it)]

print('cart_count', len(cart_items))

print('payment_cards_count', len(payment_cards))
print('payment_cards', payment_cards)
print('addresses_count', len(addresses))
print('addresses', addresses)

now = datetime.now()
print('now', now.isoformat())

# payment_cards variable exists from earlier

def is_expired(pc, dt):
    # assume expiry_month at end of month; expire if year-month is before current year-month
    exp_year = int(pc['expiry_year'])
    exp_month = int(pc['expiry_month'])
    return (exp_year, exp_month) < (dt.year, dt.month)

valid_cards = [pc for pc in payment_cards if not is_expired(pc, now)]
